Cecilia Meredith is small and dark in appearance, known for her vivacious nature. She also possesses distinctive dark-blue eyes.

## History

Cecilia Meredith was small, dark, and vivacious, with dark blue eyes. Prior to the events in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley), she passed away, leaving behind her husband, [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md), and their children.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P1](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0001), [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P6](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0006), [v5 CHAPTER IV. ## Relationships

### [Carl](../character/carl.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/carl--cecilia-meredith.md)

Cecilia is identified as the mother of [Carl](../character/carl.md) Meredith. Along with his siblings, [Carl](../character/carl.md) frequents [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley), where they socialize and share meals with the neighboring [Blythe](../character/blythe.md) children. He also plays alongside [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md) and the other manse children, sharing in their local adventures.

- Parent of  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P8](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0008)</sub>

### [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/cecilia-meredith--john-meredith.md)

Cecilia is the deceased wife of the local minister, [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md). Following her death, John becomes deeply absorbed in his theological studies and struggles with neglecting their children. He later seeks to move on by proposing to [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md), though his attempt is thwarted when [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) sends a refusal due to a promise made to her sister.

- Spouse of — deceased wife  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER XIII. THE HOUSE ON THE HILL P5](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0005), [v5 CHAPTER XIV. MRS. ALEC DAVIS MAKES A CALL P37](../source/v05-c14.md#nw-v05-c14-p0037), [v5 CHAPTER XXI. THE IMPOSSIBLE WORD P3](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0003), +2 more</sub>

### [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/cecilia-meredith--una-meredith.md)

Cecilia is the mother of [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md). [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) grows up in the manse alongside her siblings, spending her time playing in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley) with the [Blythe](../character/blythe.md) family and [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md). When a wealthy parishioner attempts to forcefully adopt [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) by claiming she is neglected, her father fiercely defends her and refuses to let her go.

- Parent of — mother  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P8](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0008), [v5 CHAPTER V. THE ADVENT OF MARY VANCE P95](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0095), [v5 CHAPTER XIV. MRS. ALEC DAVIS MAKES A CALL P18](../source/v05-c14.md#nw-v05-c14-p0018), +1 more</sub>
